analogs.covers: Lifestyle: solitary, sedentary, stubborn armoured grazer
Attitude: never flees, defends its patch from anyone

headline: A stubborn wombat in tank armour with a honey badger's refusal to back down.

setting.label: Sedentary loner of hills, woods and wetland edges
setting.note: Sedentary. Lives mostly alone or in small leaderless 'tumbles' of up to 6, and needs a rotating diet of fruit, roots, nuts and flowers.

playsLike: You are a medium, armoured herbivore that prefers its own company. Whatever food source you are eating from, plus 2 body lengths around it, is yours and you defend it from every dinosaur. You do not flee from any tier unless things turn truly dire. You only defend yourself and your own young below Sub-Adult.

why.text: Predator reaction Defensive: 'hardy and do not flee from any tier'. That is honey-badger stubbornness.
4,500 combat weight and 850 HP at Medium tier, but a slow 660 sprint. You cannot outrun anything, so you stand.
Predominantly solitary and aloof even to its own kind; young must grow fast or be left behind. Wombats are solitary and independent too.
Claims the resource it is eating from and defends it from all other dinosaurs.
Must rotate fruit, roots, nuts and flowers or it catches Gastroenteritis. It lives the life of a root-and-plant forager.

notLike: Wombats dig burrows and bolt into them; Anodontosaurus has nowhere to hide and simply stands its ground.
Honey badgers are predators; Anodontosaurus is a strict herbivore.
twist: The official inspirations also include pangolins and sea turtles: armour that predators can't bite through.
